author: ito_author

specification.title: Uncertainty and information
specification.outcome: Analyze risk attitudes and the economic value of information formally.

scope: Complete graduate chapter on uncertainty and information. Use six substantive original worked cases and twelve original solved exercises, explicit assumptions and finite-dimensional proofs. Source preparation and a compact internal blueprint are evidence, not extra approval stages: independently resolve routine choices, proceed to full working manuscript, and report material findings promptly. Root must independently review and separate peer must pass before canonical acceptance; C01/C02 acceptance precedes C03.
required_treatment: Finite-lottery expected utility: state complete/transitive mixture-continuous independent preferences, construct a cardinal affine representation with degenerate/equivalent outcomes handled, distinguish ordinal changes from positive affine changes. Give an independence violation and its exact consequence.

Increasing concave utility and risk aversion; certainty equivalents and risk premiums under explicit support/domain and strictness; Arrow-Pratt comparison under regularity, and local small-risk expansion with its approximation status.

First- and second-order stochastic dominance on finite bounded supports: complete quantifiers, correct CDF/integrated-CDF directions, proof or finite constructive argument, and equal-mean mean-preserving-spread distinction. Show incomparability using utilities or distributions.

Finite Bayesian experiments with declared prior, signals, posterior probabilities, feasible actions and payoffs. Compute optimal prior/posterior action values; distinguish weakly valuable free information from strict value, acquisition cost and changed constraints.

Finite Blackwell ordering with row/column conventions declared: garbling proof of value inequality for every finite decision problem and priors. Prove the finite converse through a carefully stated separating-hyperplane argument, or provide a complete justified equivalent finite theorem. No unsupported claim that one payoff comparison or one posterior dispersion statistic proves dominance.

Original numerical garbling and non-comparable experiments with explicit payoff witnesses; information value across different decision problems, and a research/referee case separating experiment dominance, risk attitudes, costs, empirical measurement and behavioral assumptions.
reader_deliverables: Capability/prerequisites, motivation, definitions before use, substantive intuition and derivations/proofs, six worked cases, twelve full prompt/solution pairs, boundary/counterexamples, answered teach-back and retention, source limits and deeper-study path.
Use existing chapter HTML conventions, namespace v13-c03; no canonical chapter or shared files until root promotion.

Standard-library quiet deterministic checker with independent arithmetic/proof witnesses, meaningful invalid-domain checks, strict JSON summary and no mutation. Normal workspace API plus optimized exact-four working-runtime API and CLI from unrelated cwd; keep membership/bytes unchanged. Four runtime files are manuscript/checker/source-record/author-record; source-preparation/blueprint are provenance only.
Compact source and author records with actual inspector/scope, exact bindings and unresolved issues. Do not duplicate solutions in logs.
source_policy: Browse primary official course or author sources for new specialist claims; reuse any actually inspected stable source within its scope. Record exact source URLs, dates, physical/printed pages and actual text/image inspections. Do not attribute unseen body reading. Source artifacts may be held under ../tmp/pdfs/v13-c03/; only compact provenance/proposals in assigned production records. No sources.json mutation.
ownership: No canonical curriculum/source/status/build/hosting edits, no other chapter or frozen package edits, no child agents, no paid tools/installations. All mathematics/prose/problems original; no empirical/accreditation/career guarantees.
efficiency: One focused source pass and three final gates; reuse unchanged evidence, no redundant simulation grids or verbose gate matrices.
